description: RT-F5 fixture: a non-BuiltInAgent interrupt where the interrupt `id` (int-abc) differs from the tool call id (call-xyz) and `toolCallId` is ABSENT on the interrupt. AG-UI interrupts are keyed on `id` (interruptId on resume), NOT toolCallId. Phase 4 MUST key interrupt/resume correlation on `id`; a toolCallId-keyed implementation would pass the BuiltInAgent fixture (id===toolCallId) yet break here.
